narr: Clusters of thunderstorms developed during the early afternoon hours in north Alabama. The thunderstorms produced large hail and damaging winds in Madison County. Flash flooding was also reported in Madison and Marshall Counties.
ev: Heavy rainfall caused Flash Flooding along South Memorial Parkway. A few vehicles stranded near drainage ditches that were overflowing onto the highway. Several of inches of water is flowing over the road during the heavy downpour. HEAVY DOWNPOUR.
Portions of Gunter Avenue and Sunset Drive closed due to flash flooding in Guntersville. Depth of water unknown.
Retaining wall collapsed due to heavy rainfall at Guntersville Public Library.
Flash flooding occurring along South Memorial Parkway at Mountain Gap Road. Several inches of water flowing over the road. Parking lots of businesses were flooded. Depth of water unknown.
